metaDescription: How to install the FizzleSMP modpack — step-by-step instructions for CurseForge, Modrinth, and manual installation.
ogDescription: Get FizzleSMP running in minutes. Download the pack, import it into your launcher, and connect to the server.
title: Install Guide

html: The CurseForge launcher is the recommended way to install FizzleSMP.

items: Download the latest FizzleSMP-client-X.Y.Z.zip from the latest GitHub release.
Open the CurseForge App. Go to Minecraft → Create Custom Profile → Import.
Select the downloaded .zip file. The launcher downloads all mods automatically.
Click Play. Connect to the server when the game launches.
blocks.note: The CurseForge launcher handles mod downloads, Java version, and memory allocation for you.

html: If you prefer Modrinth, grab the .mrpack file instead.

items: Download the latest FizzleSMP-client-X.Y.Z.mrpack from the latest GitHub release.
Open the Modrinth App. Click the + button → From file.
Select the .mrpack file. Mods download automatically.

html: Prism Launcher and MultiMC support both .mrpack and CurseForge .zip imports.

items: Download either the .zip or .mrpack from the latest release.
In the launcher, go to Add Instance → Import from zip.
Select the file, let it download, then launch.

items.title: Memory
html: Allocate 6–8 GB of RAM. Less than 4 GB will cause out-of-memory crashes with this many mods.

items.title: Java
html: Use Java 21 (Temurin recommended). Most launchers handle this automatically.

items.title: Shaders
html: Iris is included. Drop a shader pack into shaderpacks/ — Complementary is recommended.

When a new version is released, download the new .zip or .mrpack and import it as a new profile. Your worlds and configs are stored per-instance, so they won't be affected. Check the release notes for any migration notes.
The server pack updates in place via server-install.sh — no wipe-and-recreate. See the server deployment guide for the full operator walkthrough.

blocks.label: Install or update the server to the latest release:
blocks.code:
./server-install.sh
./server-install.sh v1.5.0    # pin to a specific version
./server-install.sh master    # install unreleased master (testing only)
